Premium offline apps. Built with passion.

CartoniQ is an independent Android development studio dedicated to building high-quality, privacy-first applications. We believe your tools should respect your privacy. That is why every app we build is 100% Offline.
We do not require user accounts. We do not track your data. We never send your personal information to the cloud. What happens on your device, stays on your device.
I am a solo Android developer who builds everything from scratch. From the initial UI/UX design to the final Kotlin code, every aspect of the CartoniQ apps is crafted with care.

What makes CartoniQ unique is how our apps are built: 100% from a mobile phone. Using Termux and modern mobile development workflows, I write the code, build the APKs, and publish them directly. This proves that with dedication and the right tools, you can build professional-grade software anywhere.
To date, over 18 premium applications have been designed and published under the CartoniQ brand.
Have a question, found a bug, or want to suggest a new feature? We would love to hear from you.

VoxMorph works on your phone. There are no accounts, no servers of ours and no analytics. Your voice recordings and the text you type are processed on your device and are never uploaded by us. The only internet use is for ads and the consent form (see Ads and consent).

We do not collect your name, email address, phone number, contacts, location, photos or files. We do not build profiles and we do not sell data. We cannot see your recordings, your text or your saved audio.

The microphone is used only while you press Record and the app is on screen. Audio is processed on your device by the voice engine. So that you can try other voices, the original recording stays in memory while the app is open and is never saved as a file; it is removed when you discard it, record again or close the app. Only the processed result is stored, and only if you tap Save.

Your text is turned into speech by the Text-to-Speech engine installed on your phone (for example Google or Samsung). VoxMorph does not send your text anywhere. How that engine handles text is described in its own privacy policy.

Saved audio and history stay in the private storage of the app. Download copies a file into your Downloads folder (or the place you choose), which you control. Share sends a file only to the app you choose. Delete, Clear all or uninstalling the app removes the saved audio from the app. Files you downloaded stay until you delete them yourself.

The free version shows ads from Google AdMob: a banner in History and an optional rewarded video that unlocks premium voices for 10 minutes. To show ads, Google may collect and use device information such as the advertising ID and IP address, according to your consent choices and the Google Privacy Policy. Where required, a consent form from Google is shown, and you can change your choice later in Settings. The developer does not receive this data. The app needs the internet only for ads and the consent form; all voice features work offline.
Microphone: to record your voice when you tap Record. Internet and network state: only for ads and the consent form. No location, contacts, camera or storage permission is requested.
VoxMorph is not directed to children under 13 and we do not knowingly collect information from children. If you are a parent or guardian and have a concern, please contact us.

Everything the app stores stays in its private area on your phone, which other apps cannot normally access. We keep nothing on our side, so there is nothing for us to delete or return. You are in control: delete recordings one by one or all at once, or uninstall the app.
If this policy changes, the new version will come with an app update and the date above will change.
